author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Tactical armaments, equipment, and catalysts for Tenebris and Lux

items.name: Ring of Fire
items.description: A crimson ring awarded for altruistically donating 500 Gold to cover Eric the Lumberjack's rent. Imbues strikes and barriers with thermal retaliation and ignites burning grid tiles.

items.name: Medusa's Sword
items.description: The ancient blade said to have severed the Gorgon. Infuses strikes with petrifying stasis and high kinetic poise severance.

items.name: Heart Shield
items.description: A tempered small shield etched with royal filigree. Grants vital defense and enhances defensive guard efficiency.

items.name: Lyri's Offering
items.description: An attunement talisman offered to the Goddess of Peace at Monica's shrine. Enhances magical attack and resonance recovery.

items.name: Light-Infused Blade
items.description: A refined steel sword bathed in the radiant glow of the Shield of Lux. Channels light severance.

items.name: Abyssal Mantle
items.description: A shadowed cloak woven from abyssal mist. Dissipates kinetic shocks and cloaks the bearer in gloom.
